title: Kissed Sweet and Gooey Irish Kabocha Pie
description: A sweet, gooey, indulgent dish featuring kabocha, smoke-cold flavor profile, high-protein-friendly, baked on a lazy-susan-spinner vessel.
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees F.
Scoop the flesh from each kabocha pumpkin, leaving about an inch of skin intact.
In a large bowl, mix sugar and butter until creamy.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Fold in flour and vanilla extract. Season with salt.
Evenly distribute the filling mixture into the hollowed kabocha pumpkins.
Place the filled kabocha pumpkins on your lazy-susan-spinner vessel and bake for 30 minutes.
Let it rest for another 15 minutes before serving.
